metadata.question: Does central Oklahoma experience more rainfall compared to northen Texas during August 10-20, 2007?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
   - Dataset: CHIRPS Daily precipitation ("UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY"), global, 1981–present.
   - Dates: 2007-08-10 to 2007-08-20 inclusive.
   - Locations: Explicit polygons for central Oklahoma and northern Texas; filter collections by the union of both.
   - Fallback: If CHIRPS has 0 images, try IMERG V06 30-min ("NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06") converting mm/hr to mm per 30 min and summing.
2. Masking strategy.
   - No cloud masking needed for precipitation products. Use all valid pixels.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error.
   - If collection size == 0 after attempts -> C1.
   - If reduceRegion pixel count == 0 for either region -> C2.
   - If mean is null/NaN -> C3.
   - Otherwise compare area-mean total rainfall (mm) for the period: central OK > north TX -> A, else B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    var centralOK = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[[-98.5,34.8],[-96.0,34.8],[-96.0,36.0],[-98.5,36.0],[-98.5,34.8]]],
      null, false
    );
    var northTX = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[[-100.5,33.0],[-97.0,33.0],[-97.0,34.8],[-100.5,34.8],[-100.5,33.0]]],
      null, false
    );
    var unionRegion = centralOK.union(northTX);
    var start = '2007-08-10';
    var end = '2007-08-21'; // end-exclusive to include Aug 20
    var scale = 5500;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    var datasetName = 'CHIRPS DAILY';
    var col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(unionRegion);
    var nImg = col.size().getInfo();
    if (nImg === 0) {
      console.log('CHIRPS images: 0 -> Fallback to IMERG V06 (30-min)');
      datasetName = 'IMERG V06 30-min (precipCal*0.5h)';
      var imerg = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(unionRegion);
      var nImgI = imerg.size().getInfo();
      if (nImgI === 0) {
        console.log('IMERG images: 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      // Convert mm/hr to mm per 30-min step and sum
      var sumImg = imerg.select('precipitationCal')
        .map(function(img){ return img.multiply(0.5).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']); })
        .sum()
        .rename('precipitation');
      nImg = nImgI;
      // Proceed with sumImg
      await doReduction(sumImg, datasetName, nImg);
      return;
    }
    // CHIRPS: sum daily totals (mm/day) to mm over the period
    var sumImg = col.select('precipitation').sum().rename('precipitation');
    await doReduction(sumImg, datasetName, nImg);

    async function doReduction(sumImage, dsName, imageCount) {
      // 3. Processing: Pixel counts and means
      var meanOK = sumImage.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: centralOK,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('precipitation').getInfo();
      var countOK = sumImage.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: centralOK,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('precipitation').getInfo();

      var meanTX = sumImage.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: northTX,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('precipitation').getInfo();
      var countTX = sumImage.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: northTX,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('precipitation').getInfo();

      // 4. Validation
      console.log(`Dataset: ${dsName} | Images: ${imageCount} | Dates: 2007-08-10..20`);
      if (!countOK || !countTX || countOK === 0 || countTX === 0) {
        console.log(`Pixels OK: ${countOK || 0}, TX: ${countTX || 0}`);
        console.log('C2');
        return;
      }
      if (meanOK === null || meanTX === null || isNaN(meanOK) || isNaN(meanTX)) {
        console.log(`Means invalid -> OK:${meanOK}, TX:${meanTX}`);
        console.log('C3');
        return;
      }

      // 5. Results and Final Answer
      var diff = meanOK - meanTX;
      console.log(`Central OK mean_total_mm: ${meanOK.toFixed(2)} | pixels: ${countOK}`);
      console.log(`North TX   mean_total_mm: ${meanTX.toFixed(2)} | pixels: ${countTX}`);
      console.log(`Difference (OK - TX): ${diff.toFixed(2)} mm`);
      if (diff > 0) {
        console.log('A');
      } else {
        console.log('B');
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
